scope: Public read-only RPC. No private key, live mutation, account query or load test.

rpc_agreement.policy: Both endpoints must agree on chain, finalized anchor, code and all getters; any failure blocks. No majority or latest fallback.
rpc_agreement.limitation: Distinct endpoint hosts do not prove independent operators; agreement does not establish source-bytecode equivalence or release readiness.

blocker: ObservationError: primary: eth_chainId: HTTPError: HTTP status 403
